title: Image Embeddings JSON Schema
description: A representation for the vector embedding representation of the content-items of type image.

ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the embedding was created (e.g., '2024-10-09T09:29:02Z').

size.description: The size of the embedding vector.

oneOf.description: The vector embedding representation of the content item as a single list.

items.description: A single number in the vector embedding of the document.

seconds.description: Number of seconds it took to generate the embedding for this image.

title_year.description: Title-year key this image embeddings corresponds to.
